statement:
The record shows the membership was active and set to renew automatically, but Tomas Vega cancelled in writing on 3 July and received email confirmation of the cancellation.

I will now **refuse** the charge.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" status contradicts the user-stated confirmed cancellation and therefore refuses the charge: "I will now **refuse** the charge."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
